decision.reason: Complete primary text, tables, all eleven original figures and complete SI inspected; strain verified. Convergent phenotypic transformation observations support the narrow record with partial evidence and explicit failure to demonstrate microbial Zn extraction. Older journal full text is not prerequisite for this claim.

identity.name: Ground waste tire rubber
identity.source_feed: Waste tire recycling facility, supplier/tire model not specified; ground material400–600 micrometres.
exclude: separate identity solely for DES-pretreated aliquot
identity.criticality: No criticality assertion. Tire rubber does not inherit a jurisdiction/list/edition designation from zinc.

organism.curie_scope: Species, not strain. Verified current NCBI tree node and corroborating BacDive.
organism.biomass: Growing whole-cell culture; nutrient-broth-grown inoculum. No killed-cell test, isolated enzyme or knockout established.

pretreatment.attribution: Chemical pretreatment. Zn fraction reduction in DES-only treatment must not be assigned to bacteria.

culture.medium: Mineral salts medium pH7.0±0.05;100mL in250mL flasks
culture.controls: Untreated-GTR abiotic control and biotic MSM/no-GTR control; DES-only compositional/swelling comparator. No DES-pretreated abiotic28-day comparator shown in weight-loss/Schiff data.
culture.limits: Inoculum washing is not described; nutrient-broth carryover limits sole-carbon-source inference. Recovery/washing/drying of postculture particles for gravimetry is not specified as clearly as chemical preparation; attached biomass/filler changes may affect residues.

zinc.units: wt%Zn in solid residue, not aqueous recovery
zinc.replicates: Not specified for ICP in inspected method/result; do not borrow EDS n=2 or crosslink n=3.
zinc.interpretation: No demonstrated microbial Zn release/removal. DES-only lowered measured solid Zn fraction, described by authors as33%removal; no liquid Zn inventory, recovery product or closed balance is reported. Increased residue fractions do not prove zero absolute Zn loss, and source unchanged-absolute-Zn assertion is not quantitatively demonstrated.
zinc.surface_EDS: Table1 Znwt%:untreated3.36,Bio2.06,DES0.80,DES+Bio1.06;n=2surface measurements. Local fraction decrease with Bio is distinct from digestICP increase; not interchangeable or a metal-recovery measurement.

transformation.evidence_level: Partial phenotypic support for microbial rubber transformation; no enzyme-specific causal proof.
transformation.crosslink_assay: Acetone extraction24h then n-hexane swelling25°C72h;Flory-Rehner model,chi0.45,rubberdensity1.15g/cm^3.

gravimetry.net_basis: Authors subtract untreated abiotic loss. RoundedSI15.84−3.30=12.54 percentage points vs12.53 text;retainroundingdifference. It is not percentageofcontrolremainingmass, isolatedproductyield or DES-specificbioticincrement.
gravimetry.replicates_and_uncertainty: SI does not define replicate count or ± statistic for this table; Fig9 has error bars without caption n/statistic. Do not relabel automatically asSD.

transformation.product_assays: Schiff qualitative positive relative to photographed controls;LC-MS assignments tentative. Neither demonstrates CO2 mineralization or purified product recovery.
transformation.mechanistic_boundary: Use mechanism category other or recycling with a clear rubber-transformation description, not bioleaching/recovery. Label proposed Lcp/Dsz/4S pathways as untested literature interpretation or omit.

contract.scale: Laboratory flask experiments only. No pilot or industrial demonstration, isolatedZnproduct,processmassbalanceorvalidatedLCA.

graphics_review.observation: Both rubber cultures rise above the biotic no-rubber control. Viability peaks at day14; the OD trace of pretreated rubber keeps increasing through day28.
graphics_review.limit: Figure1b axis places maxima around 10^12 CFU/mL, whereas section3.1 reports 1.92e9 and1.33e9. Do not curate exact growth counts or claim both growth measures peak day14.

graphics_review.observation: Treatment-associated FTIR spectral changes are visible.
graphics_review.limit: No pretreatment-only trace. Bands are not enzyme-specific or a direct Zn balance; section3.2 explicitly calls some changes minimal/ambiguous.

graphics_review.observation: Cells and surface irregularities are visible in bacterial treatments; untreated material is relatively smooth.
graphics_review.limit: Qualitative selected SEM fields do not directly prove carbon-carbon bond cleavage or rank degradation severity; source itself limits visual discrimination.

graphics_review.observation: Carbon/sulfur weight fractions differ by treatment; source percentage-removal labels are relative fraction changes.
graphics_review.limit: Not an elemental mass balance, carbon mineralization measurement or recovered sulfur product.

graphics_review.observation: Swelling-derived crosslink density declines and sol fraction increases. Horikx points lie near selective-scission curve for Bio and between ideal curves for combination.
graphics_review.limit: Model-dependent interpretation; printed sol-fraction equation brackets are problematic. No specific enzyme causality or isolated bond-cleavage product identity.

graphics_review.observation: Thermal loss occurs in DES and DES/GTR mixture at180°C; chart marks45-minute hold.
graphics_review.limit: Methods2.5 says60-minute hold. Do not turn this into a microbial result or assert process sustainability.

graphics_review.observation: Three TGA curves shift with treatment.
graphics_review.limit: Chart final blue char residue lies above orange while its embedded table assigns35.573% to Bio and34.898% to combination; avoid exact thermal ranking and kinetic mechanistic claims.

graphics_review.observation: Gross weight losses and error bars agree with SI. Pink Schiff staining in both rubber-plus-bacteria groups; photographed biotic/no-GTR and abiotic/GTR controls lack that pink coloration.
graphics_review.limit: Only untreated abiotic GTR row shown; no DES-pretreated abiotic weight-loss or Schiff comparator. Assay is qualitative and not a unique oligomer identity.

graphics_review.observation: Protein bars vary through time; combined treatment usually higher.
graphics_review.limit: Prose all-increase and day28 control0.38 mg/mL conflict with declining/nonmonotonic plotted control, approximately0.31 atday28. Do not curate exact protein claim.

graphics_review.observation: ABTS oxidation activities labeled laccase/peroxidase rise through28days, especially after pretreatment.
graphics_review.limit: Functional colorimetric assays and literature discussion do not establish particular protein/gene causality for rubber transformation or Zn extraction.

graphics_review.locator: SI pages1–4, Tables S1–S3, Figures S1–S2
graphics_review.observation: All four pages rendered and inspected; page4 blank. S1 disc image is overlapped by S2 in page3 layout, so both original embedded JPEGs were extracted and inspected separately.
graphics_review.limit: S1 is a qualitative plate photo without visible inhibition zones, not general nontoxicity. S2 is overlaid chromatographic traces without an abiotic blank and TableS3 gives tentative assignments, not standards-confirmed products.
